name.text: Exercise Q3a: Proof that XAY is a straight line

questiontext.text:
1. Arrange the steps in the correct order to prove the statement below. Make sure your proof logically connects each step, starting with the assumptions and ending with the conclusion.

    Theorem: {@thm@}


    [[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox', { boundingbox: [-2, -8, 7, 4], axis: false, visible:false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false, keepAspectRatio: true }); // Define triangle vertices var A = board.create('point', [0, 0], {name:'A', size:1}); var B = board.create('point', [6, 0], {name:'B', size:1}); var C = board.create('point', [0, -6], {name:'C', size:1}); // Draw triangle sides var lineAB = board.create('line', [A, B], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:1}); var lineAC = board.create('line', [A, C], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:1}); var lineBC = board.create('line', [B, C], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:1}); // Mark right angle at vertex A board.create('angle', [C, A, B], { radius:0.7, name:' ', type:'sector', fillColor:'lightgray', fillOpacity:0.5 }); // Mark right angle at vertex C board.create('angle', [B,C,A], { radius:0.7, name:' ', type:'sector', fillColor:'red', fillOpacity:0.5 }); // Mark right angle at vertex B board.create('angle', [A,B,C], { radius:0.7, name:' ', type:'sector', fillColor:'green', fillOpacity:0.5 }); // Label angles of the triangle // board.create('text', [0, -5, '{#angle_BCA#}'+'°']); board.create('text', [5, -0.2, '{#angle_CBA#}'+'°']); // Line passing through A using three points var X = board.create('point', [-4, -2], {name:'X', visible:true, size:1}); var Y = board.create('point', [4, 2], {name:'Y', visible:true, size:1}); var lineXY = board.create('line', [X, Y], { strokeColor:'red', strokeWidth:1 }); // Label angles along XY line board.create('text', [-1, -1, '{#angle_CAX#}'+'°']); // board.create('text', [1, 0.3, '{#angle_YAB#}'+'°']); [[/jsxgraph]]
    [[parsons input="ans1" log="true"]] {# parsons_encode(proof_steps) #} [[/parsons]]
